title: Divine Mercy - Videos
description:
The Divine Mercy Channel is home to the Marian Fathers, the official promoters of the Divine Mercy message since 1941. 

Discover the eternal truth of Catholic teachings, watch the Holy Catholic Mass LIVE daily and explore the Catholic faith on shows such as Living Divine Mercy, Explaining the Faith, Ask a Marian, and more brought to you by the likes of Fr. Chris Alar, Fr. Donald Calloway, and many other Marian Fathers.
To learn more about The Divine Mercy, visit www.TheDivineMercy.org
* The Marians are a Congregation of more than 500 priests and brothers in 19 countries around the world.
* They support the Holy Father and embrace the official teachings of the Catholic Church in our special calling to:
* Spread devotion to Mary as the Immaculate Conception
* Offer our lives for the Holy Souls in Purgatory, especially the victims of war and disease
* Operate publishing apostolates and assisting parishes, shrines, schools and missions
© 2026 Marian Fathers of the Immaculate Conception.
